# Parsley

> Causal delivery order for Kafka Streams processors. If message A is a cause of message B,
> every process that delivers both delivers A first, across restarts and for the whole
> lifetime of a process. Causal safety is inviolable: a process blocks or stops, and never
> reorders, drops, or resolves a wait by timeout.

Parsley is a Java 21 library, MIT licensed, for Kafka Streams applications. The runtime
dependencies are kafka-clients, kafka-streams and slf4j-api. One declared process becomes one Kafka
Streams application running under exactly_once_v2 and read_committed. The on-wire footprint
is one record header, `parsley.causes`, on the application's own records. There are no
protocol records, and plain consumers decode key and value with the application's own serdes
alone.

The delivery discipline is that of causal broadcast, indexed by channel rather than by
process, over Lamport's happened-before relation. The correctness gate is a deterministic
simulator checked against a happened-before oracle, run by `mvn verify`, together with
integration tests against an embedded KRaft broker.

This file describes version 0.3.0-SNAPSHOT, the Maven artifact
`io.github.tobyjamesclements:parsley:0.3.0-SNAPSHOT`, resolved from the Central snapshots
repository (https://central.sonatype.com/repository/maven-snapshots/). Every link below tracks
the main branch. The current release is 0.2.0, resolved from Maven Central, and it is the one
to depend on unless you are tracking unreleased work. The 0.1.0 release is a different
implementation, whose API and wire format both differ from this version, and stays addressable
by its version number.

## Overview

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/index.md): the guarantee, the scope, and the shape of an application

## Protocol

- [Model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/model.md): specification terms in Kafka, the causal frontier, pruning and growth
- [Delivery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/delivery.md): settled positions, the delivery decision, order and duplicates
- [State](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/state.md): ordering state layout, persistence and recovery
- [Wire format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/wire-format.md): the frozen, normative definition of the causal metadata header

## Operation

- [Failing closed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/failing-closed.md): what stops a process, the blast radius, and every refusal reason
- [Runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/runtime.md): start sequence, configuration lockdown, facts ingestion, the handler seam
- [Operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/operations.md): what a process is named on the cluster, what must exist first, scaling, resetting a process, and sizing the metadata budget and record limits
- [Session consistency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/session.md): carrying the causal frontier past the last consumer, out to clients
- [API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/api.md): the packages and where the generated Javadoc lives

## Verification

- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/docs/verification.md): the test layers, the sabotage meta-tests, and the standard of evidence
- [Decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tobyjamesclements/parsley/main/DECISIONS.md): every choice the specification left open, numbered and append-only, with the alternatives rejected; later records correct earlier ones in place of editing them
